_comment: Golden values for samples/tacit_boot on chipyard_pynqz1 -- TACIT captured from Rocket on the physical PYNQ-Z1 starting at the RESET VECTOR, not at main(). arch/riscv/core/reset.S (patches/0003-zephyr-startup-tacit-dma-sink.patch) programs the DMA sink address and the encoder target before asserting enable. scripts/23_rocket_tacit_boot.sh compares against this.
_not_checked: tacit_out_bytes is deliberately absent, for the same reason as expected/tacit_dma.json: every packet carries a delta timestamp in core cycles, so a DRAM refresh shifts a varint and the total moves by a few bytes. Seven consecutive runs measured 147093-147101 bytes. The counts below carry the same +/-0.2% tolerance tacit_dma.json uses, and they need it: six of those seven runs decoded to exactly 117423 packets / 563711 instructions / 681135 lines, and one to 117422 / 563709 / 681132 -- two instructions, from the periodic mtime interrupt landing a few cycles earlier. perfetto_begin_slices was 10064 in all seven and is checked exactly.
_evidence: boot_symbols and first_slice are what make this a BOOT trace rather than a bigger workload trace. A byte count cannot tell those apart; a slice named z_prep_c can. The list is Zephyr's early boot path as it also appears in Lab A's Spike trace (expected/tacit.json).
